subject: Re: Fernwell integration - script for review

messages.body:
Hi Sam,

Here's my script for the integration, going live on Oct 8. Let me know what you think!

---
[0:00] Hook: "I used to lose three hours a week just deciding what to work on."
[0:08] Honestly this app changed my life, it's the best productivity app ever made and it will double your grades.
[0:20] Walkthrough: I open Fernwell, drag my assignments into the week view, and it builds my study blocks automatically.
[0:45] Show the streaks screen.
[0:55] Outro: that's it, go check it out.
---

Priya
